examples.title: ⌘K palette
examples.description: The button or ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows and Linux) opens it; Esc closes it.

a11y: The search box is a combobox that controls a listbox; focus stays in it and aria-activedescendant points at the highlighted command.
Commands are role="option", grouped under labelled role="group" headings; groups with no matches disappear.
Keys: ↓ ↑ to move (they wrap), Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End for the first and last, Enter to run, Esc to close the palette.
"No results found" is a status message, so screen readers announce it.
Shortcuts are shown for sighted users and hidden from screen readers, which read the command's name.
